name: Surgical Bay
description: The fifth sphere of New Phyrexia, dominated by the Progress Engine of Jin-Gitaxias, a toxic quicksilver sea of experimentation.

description_citations.text: "Surgical Bay". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias takes over the Surgical Bay and expands the oil reservoir.
timeline.quote: it was later taken over by Jin-Gitaxias, who drained the Quicksilver Sea above into it

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Spheres of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ixhel uses the Surgical Bay to create a new being from the parts she took, and brings it to Atraxa.
timeline.quote: Except this time, you have made something.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Hollow Body" by Aysha U. Farah. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: After New Phyrexia's structure is built, the sea is transplanted to the fifth sphere as the Surgical Bay.
timeline.quote: The Quicksilver Sea was transplanted to the fifth sphere and transformed into the Surgical Bay .

citation.text: "Quicksilver Sea", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias overtakes the region, drains the Quicksilver Sea and converts it into a domain of experimentation, creating the Surgical Bay.
timeline.quote: Draining the Quicksilver Sea from above, he pooled its contents into this subterranean reservoir and converted it into a domain of experimentation.

citation.text: "Surgical Bay", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Searching for Karn, Elspeth, Koth and Venser travel through the Surgical Bay.
timeline.quote: planeswalkers Elspeth Tirel , Koth , and Venser traveled through the Surgical Bay

citation.text: "Surgical Bay", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: In Jin-Gitaxias's domain, strange and terrible experiments iterate toward perfection, unbound by ethics.

citation.text: The Surgical Bay (Phyrexia: All Will Be One, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
